name: Anteats
subtitle: UCI dining, gym & study
promotional_text: Live UCI menus, campus food hours, ARC + library busyness, widgets, and opening alerts — built by an Anteater.
description:
Anteats is the unofficial UCI companion for eating, working out, and finding a quiet place to study — in one native iOS app.

EAT
• Live menus for The Anteatery and Brandywine with calories, allergens, and dietary filters (Vegan, Vegetarian, Halal, Kosher, Gluten-Free)
• Countdowns like “Dinner starts in 16m,” browse tomorrow’s menu, and land on the meal happening right now
• Full nutrition on dishes (macros + expandable label/ingredients)
• Build today’s plate with a running calorie/protein tally
• Favorite dishes and get a ping when they’re being served

CAMPUS
• Hours and open/closed for Starbucks, Panda, Subway, Zot N Go, food courts, and more
• Filter by category or “open now”; opening alerts for the spots you care about

GYM & STUDY
• ARC status with live busyness when available
• Library occupancy floor by floor, with a quietest-right-now pick

WIDGETS & MORE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen / StandBy widgets for halls, today’s menu, campus, ARC, and quietest library
• Live Activity meal countdown on Dynamic Island
• Full dark mode · no accounts · no ads · no tracking

Unofficial student project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by UC Irvine. Data comes from public campus endpoints that may change.
whats_new: My Plate is easier to find when empty, remove is clearer, Clear asks before wiping, and browsing tomorrow keeps today’s plate one tap away.
review_notes:
No login or account is required. The app reads public UCI dining, campus food, ARC, and library busyness endpoints only.

Demo path for review:
1. Open the Eat tab — menus load automatically for today’s meal.
2. Tap a dish for macros / nutrition / allergens. Use the blue Add to My Plate button (or + on a row); heart Favorites is secondary.
3. Open My Plate via the My Plate chip (empty) or the blue tally bar (filled). Remove with minus / Remove from My Plate; Clear plate confirms when multiple dishes are listed.
4. Open Settings (gear) → Notifications → Send test notification; optionally enable Opening alerts.
5. Visit Campus, Gym, and Study tabs for live hours / busyness.
6. Optional: add Anteats Home Screen widgets from the iOS widget gallery.

Privacy: Data Not Collected. Preferences stay on-device. Unofficial student project; not affiliated with UC Irvine.
